en: Gods, what am I supposed to do with this mess...?

en: Er, that might sound strange. It's a very... unique, new type of virus.
ja: ええ、妙に　聞こえるでしょうね。とても……特殊で　新しい種類の　ウイルスなんです。

key: If you want to see what I mean, feel free to log in and try it, but make sure you're ready.
en: If you want to see what I mean, feel free to log in and try it, but make sure you're ready.
ja: 意味を　確かめたければ　ログインして　試して　かまいません。ただし　準備は　しておいてください。

key: It's a very... unique, new type of virus.
en: It's a very... unique, new type of virus.
ja: とても……特殊で　新しい種類の　ウイルスです。

en: This is a Sticker for Reborn City's Department Store.  They're coveted, but of course largely useless up here.
ja: これは　リボーンシティの　デパートの　シールです。人気は　ありますが　ここでは　ほとんど　役に立ちません。

en: So please, take it.

en: That is unfortunate, but should you get one, please return and I can give this to you.
ja: 残念です。手に入れたら　また　来てください。その時に　お渡ししましょう。

en: Now that that's sorted, I can get back to solo queue...

en: Ahm, I mean, processing my solo queue of very important administrative work.

en: Most impressive!
ja: 実に　見事です!

en: This is a great relief. Please, allow me to offer my thanks!
ja: 本当に　助かりました。どうか　お礼を　させてください!

key: The mountain is harsh and unforgiving.
en: The mountain is harsh and unforgiving.
ja: この山は　厳しく　容赦がない。

key: But still we humans choose to live, each for our own reasons, in this environment.
en: But still we humans choose to live, each for our own reasons, in this environment.
ja: それでも　人は　それぞれの理由で　この環境に　住むことを　選ぶ。

key: Pokémon are the same.
en: Pokémon are the same.
ja: ポケモンも　同じだ。

key: Some unusual selections find themselves residing in the snow banks and caves of Ametrine Mountain.
en: Some unusual selections find themselves residing in the snow banks and caves of Ametrine Mountain.
ja: アメトリン山の　雪原や　どうくつには　珍しい　顔ぶれが　住みついている。

key: Sometimes they are ill-suited to it.
en: Sometimes they are ill-suited to it.
ja: その環境に　向いていない　ものも　いる。

key: I wonder if that Pokémon is still out there somewhere...
en: I wonder if that Pokémon is still out there somewhere...
ja: あのポケモンは　まだ　どこかに　いるのだろうか……

key: Hm... So you saw that Lucario, did you?
en: Hm... So you saw that Lucario, did you?
ja: ふむ……あのルカリオを　見たのですね?

key: Whether by treachery or by tragedy, it was abandoned here by a Trainer some time ago.
en: Whether by treachery or by tragedy, it was abandoned here by a Trainer some time ago.
ja: 裏切りか　悲劇か……いずれにせよ　少し前に　トレーナーに　ここへ　捨てられたのです。

key: Whatever the case, it seems to resent humans.
en: Whatever the case, it seems to resent humans.
ja: どちらにせよ　人間を　憎んでいるようです。

key: It's decided living in the chilled caves of Ametrine was more preferable than accepting help-- or captivity-- from humans.
en: It's decided living in the chilled caves of Ametrine was more preferable than accepting help-- or captivity-- from humans.
ja: 人の助け……あるいは　囚われの身に　なるより　アメトリンの　冷たいどうくつで　暮らすほうが　ましだと　決めたのでしょう。

key: Indeed, it might be impossible to catch, but...
en: Indeed, it might be impossible to catch, but...
ja: たしかに　捕まえるのは　不可能かも　しれませんが……

key: If you are determined, I'm sure it could be found somewhere around this icy mountain.
en: If you are determined, I'm sure it could be found somewhere around this icy mountain.
ja: 本気で　探すなら　この　氷の山の　どこかで　見つかるはずです。

key: Hrm? You saw the Lucario with an Egg?
en: Hrm? You saw the Lucario with an Egg?
ja: ほう? ルカリオが　タマゴを　持っていたと?

key: Interesting... I hadn't anticipated that.
en: Interesting... I hadn't anticipated that.
ja: 興味深い……それは　予想外です。

key: But it does explain the Pokémon's behavior.
en: But it does explain the Pokémon's behavior.
ja: しかし　それなら　あのポケモンの　行動にも　説明が　つきます。

key: It's been lurking strangely close to the city for how averse it seems to be to humans.
en: It's been lurking strangely close to the city for how averse it seems to be to humans.
ja: 人を　あれほど　嫌うわりに　妙に　街の近くを　うろついていましたから。

key: Perhaps...
en: Perhaps...
ja: おそらく……

key: And this is just a guess, mind you...
en: And this is just a guess, mind you...
ja: あくまで　推測ですが……

key: Perhaps it's seeking someone to look after its child.
en: Perhaps it's seeking someone to look after its child.
ja: 子どもを　世話してくれる　相手を　探しているのかも　しれません。

key: Lucario herself hides away in the cold due to her distaste of Trainers, but perhaps even she realizes this is no place to raise a Riolu like that.
en: Lucario herself hides away in the cold due to her distaste of Trainers, but perhaps even she realizes this is no place to raise a Riolu like that.
ja: ルカリオ自身は　トレーナーを　嫌って　寒さの中に　身を隠していますが、あんな場所で　リオルを　育てるのは　無理だと　気づいたのでしょう。

key: That creature must have had a very hard life with its past owner...
en: That creature must have had a very hard life with its past owner...
ja: あのポケモンは　前の持ち主のもとで　よほど　つらい思いを　したのでしょう……

key: At any rate, Lucario may find some sort of small cave for a temporary shelter.
en: At any rate, Lucario may find some sort of small cave for a temporary shelter.
ja: ともあれ　ルカリオは　仮の住みかに　小さなどうくつを　探すかも　しれません。

key: Perhaps seeking such a place would be the best way to meet Lucario again...
en: Perhaps seeking such a place would be the best way to meet Lucario again...
ja: そういう場所を　探すのが　もう一度　ルカリオに　会う　いちばんの　方法でしょう……

key: So Lucario fled... apparently leaving the Egg to you?
en: So Lucario fled... apparently leaving the Egg to you?
ja: ルカリオは　去った……タマゴを　あなたに　託して?

key: Is that so...
en: Is that so...
ja: そうですか……

key: With its strength, I'm sure we can trust Lucario will be well.
en: With its strength, I'm sure we can trust Lucario will be well.
ja: あの強さなら　ルカリオは　きっと　無事でしょう。

key: Then it is up to you to raise that Egg with the care Lucario herself did not receive.
en: Then it is up to you to raise that Egg with the care Lucario herself did not receive.
ja: ならば　ルカリオ自身が　受けられなかった　愛情を　そのタマゴに　注ぐのは　あなたの　役目です。

key: May it have a better life.
en: May it have a better life.
ja: よりよい　人生を　送れますように。

key: Welcome!
en: Welcome!
ja: いらっしゃいませ!

ja: この子たちは　手が　かかるけど、この騒ぎの中でも　元気で　いてくれるのは　うれしいわ。
